batch_upsert_tools: batch upsert tool discovery queue items into the LiteLLM tool registry database
list_tools: list all registered tools from the LiteLLM tool registry, optionally filtered by input policy
update_tool_policy: update input and output policy settings for a specific tool in the tool registry
get_effective_policies: get effective input policies for a list of tools respecting blocked tool permissions
add_tool_to_object_permission_blocked: add a tool name to an object permission's blocked tools list
